name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – Before § 1 – Am 2
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: -1. Calls for a significant increase in the EU budget to address the socio-economic plight that peoples and Member States are facing, which has been compounded by, among other factors, the spiralling cost of living;
